verdict.rationale: Motion's docs describe automatic rescheduling that 'reshuffles your entire day (and week) in seconds—protecting your time' when meetings run long or emergencies arise, and recurring tasks are auto-blocked on the calendar regularly, which aligns with defending and flexibly moving recurring commitments rather than dropping them. However, none of the evidence specifically discusses 'habits' as a distinct object or shows hands-on proof that recurring focus blocks are prioritized/rescheduled over being silently dropped in real conflict scenarios. Missing for 10: explicit habit-tracking feature documentation, and independent/hands-on evidence confirming recurring blocks survive conflicts rather than being deprioritized.
